editorial:
You're dropped into a city where bodies start turning up with the signature marks of a killer who died years ago. Detectives Halloran and Hunt try to connect the dots while a group of strangers wakes up in a barn full of deadly traps. The movie mixes police work with survival horror, so you get both a mystery and a race against time. It feels like a return to the old Saw style, with puzzles, blood, and a ticking clock. The tone is dark but not too heavy, and the story keeps you guessing about who is really pulling the strings.

The traps are creative and nasty, and the cast does a solid job selling the panic. Pacing moves quickly, though some twists feel a little too neat. If you like horror with a mystery angle, you'll have fun. Fans of the series will appreciate the callbacks, while newcomers can still follow along. Watch it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn Logan, the medical examiner, is the new Jigsaw. He survived an earlier trap and secretly carried out the new game. He frames Halloran and kills him, then reveals the barn events happened years earlier. The victims were already dead, and the police were chasing old evidence. Logan walks away as the new mastermind, setting up more games.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves horror mysteries and survival traps.
